name: @psyb0t/modembox
summary: Connect to a self-hosted ModemBox over MCP.
description: Tools list modems and SMS, retrieve or send messages, unlock SIMs and forget saved PINs, dial, answer and hang up, play and stop WAV audio, capture caller audio and run AT commands. https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-modembox

MODEMBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your ModemBox instance, for example http://localhost:8000. The bridge appends /mcp.

MODEMBOX_TOKEN.description: Operator bearer token when the ModemBox instance requires authentication.

url.description: Base URL of your ModemBox instance.

token.description: Operator bearer token when the instance requires authentication.
